description: The one verdict that is named and still passes. An entry for a package this project does not hold has no surface to be wrong against — a monorepo where one workspace holds the dependency and another does not would otherwise fail the run over a file that is right — so it is reported apart, and the exit code says nothing was refused rather than that everything reached. Asserted alone because the mixed case cannot show it: one entry that reaches nothing sets the exit for all of them.
